- Wire routing (domestic): 122000661; Swift: FCUSUS33

Hi Liam —

Thanks, received. I’ll kick this to Finance (cc’d Marissa & Priyom) to validate the micro-deposits and wire test. A few quick asks so we can finish vendor activation and ensure POs flow cleanly into payments: 

1) Can you confirm whether the ACH account above is for both invoicing and refunds? We prefer a single remittance account but can accept separate settlement accounts if needed.
2) In your sample CSV the PO field is labeled "Invoice/PO Ref" — can you confirm the canonical value we should look up ("PO_REF" vs "INVOICE_REF")? We want to avoid duplicate mappings when our AP system auto-labels.
3) If you have a legal entity name different from "Solstice Ventures, Inc." for 1099s, please attach — otherwise the W-9 you sent is sufficient.

Next steps on our side: Marissa will validate routing/account via micro-deposit and confirm when she sees both deposits. Once validated we’ll finalize the PO-to-remit mapping and send the vendor ID + expected PO prefix for your invoices.

Thanks — I’ll flag when Finance confirms.

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Vendor Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — Finance validated both micro-deposits at 10:15 PT this morning. Vendor record created (Vendor ID: V-2026-3159). A few operational notes to close out the ticket: 

- Confirmed account is used for invoices & refunds.
- We will map incoming CSV column "PO_REF" to the Redwood payments field "po_reference" (lowercase) so your PO values should surface on payout reconciliation.
- Expected PO prefix we apply for Solstice is "SV-" (internal only) — please continue to include the full PO value on invoices; our reconciliation tolerates either "SV-12345" or bare "12345" but mapping is cleaner with the prefix.

Marissa, please open a quick payment run test next week and mark vendor V-2026-3159 as "Active" in the payee system. Liam, once you see a small test payment, please confirm the remittance CSV layout is as expected.

Thanks — welcome aboard.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Global Finance Systems
Redwood Inference
